cases.description: Verify POST /api/email/resend/webhook records a delivered event without any sign-in.
procedure: Build the body { "type": "email.delivered", "created_at": "<now ISO>", "data": { "email_id": "<provider id>", "to": ["<recipient>"] } }.

Compute svix-signature as "v1," + base64(HMAC-SHA256(key = base64-decoded part of the secret after "whsec_", message = <svix-id> + "." + <svix-timestamp> + "." + <raw body>)); svix-timestamp is the current Unix time in seconds.
Send POST /api/email/resend/webhook with headers svix-id, svix-timestamp, svix-signature, Content-Type: application/json and the body; no Authorization header.
expected: HTTP 200 OK with no message code.
The email row now has delivery_state "Delivered" and delivery_state_at equal to the event's created_at; its status stays "Sent".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Email:Resend:WebhookSecret is set on the test build; QA lead supplies the secret and a queued email row with status "Sent" whose provider id is known.
